name: git log
purpose: Read and inspect the project's commit history.
explanation: Step 5 (Read History) of the Git workflow. Displays past commits; '--oneline' shows a compact view with Short IDs and commit messages.

parameters.description: Compact single-line view showing Short IDs and commit messages.

whenToUse: To review past checkpoints and commit IDs.
commonMistakes: Confusing git log (commit history) with git status (working tree state).
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `git log` in a standard Unix-like shell.
commonErrors: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

beforeAfterState.before: Repository working tree / index / history prior to command.
